use_case: Container and berth scheduling optimization: recommended berth windows, crane splits, yard slots and truck appointment slots (SYS-12)
vendor_or_model: Scheduling optimization SaaS vendor (optimization with machine-learning predictions of dwell and move times)
data_categories: Vessel schedules; bay plans; container attributes including hazardous class and weight; yard inventory; equipment status; truck appointments with driver names (Confidential)
human_in_the_loop: Planner approves every berth and yard plan in the TOS; independent constraint check blocks unsafe plans (due 2026-11-30); customer service approves appointment slots
applicable_laws: 33 CFR Part 101 Subpart F (101.650(b)(3); 101.650(f)); 46 U.S.C. 41106; OSHA 29 CFR part 1917; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Approved with conditions (advisory mode); appointment slot recommendations suspended
